newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to issue $500 million yankee bonds.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to issue $500 million yankee bonds.

text.p: Thai finance minister Amnuay Viravan said on Thursday the ministry plans to issue bonds worth $500 million in the U.S. market to finance the government's infrastructure projects.

"It's the appropriate time to issue bonds in the U.S. market right now because the U.S. interest rates are relatively low and foreign investors still have confidence in Thailand's credit rating," Amnuay told reporters.
The planned bond would have maturity of 10 and 30 years and be issued by the end of April, he said.
